mentions.h: 20th May-TOOTING v SLH v London AC v HHH v Kent AC v Wimbledon AC.
COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIPS - Surrey - MOTSPUR PARK - May, 26th.
Major prominent in South of Thames Senior
Chris Martin 2nd in SURREY CO. CHAMPS.
mentions.note: spiked and dropped out of 3 miles

photos.c: Geoff North (10) leads Gowan (110), Presland (211) and Thresher (3) in the opening match at Wimbledon.

FRONTISPIECE(Photo:R.Linstead) Geoff. North, who has had such a fine track season, set a new Belgrave 2 miles record of 8:43.0 in the AAA v London University match at Motspur Park early this season. He is seen here leading Mick Gowan, another of the "Lauriston Cottage community".
TOP: At 2½ miles Gerry North (12) leads Roger Robinson of Guildford; while John Thresher (17), in fourth place, fights Mick Gowan (HHH) in the Surrey Championship.
